title: Gemini Enterprise

body.text: At the enterprise level, Google offers
Gemini for Workspace enterprise edition: data not used for training, admin controls, audit, and compliance
— including grounding with internal company data for answers based on real company context.

example: "An employee asks 'what's our WFH policy?' — Gemini answers from the internal HR documents, not general knowledge"

title: Gemini Advanced course wrap-up

body.text: Deep Research, NotebookLM, Thinking, creative (Imagen/Veo), API, AI Studio, Vertex, and Workspace
— Gemini's strength is integrating with the Google tools you already use; start there to see results fastest.

example: "Capstone: pick one routine task in Gmail/Docs/Sheets and use Gemini to do it faster this week"

question: How does Gemini Enterprise handle organization data?

options.text: Not used for training, with controls and audit

question: What does grounding with internal data mean?

options.text: Answering based on the organization's real documents

question: What's Gemini's main strength vs other AIs?

options.text: Integrating with the Google tools people already use
Being the only AI in the world

question: How do you get the most from advanced Gemini?

options.text: Pick the tool (Deep Research/NotebookLM/API) that fits the task
Use the same tool for everything

question: What should you always do when using AI to research information?

options.text: Verify the sources before using it
